name: Katsu Chicken curry
assumptions: Recipe instructions explicitly state total time of 45 minutes (15 min prep + 30 min cook).
Yield estimated at 4 based on 4 chicken breasts as primary protein, standard for this dish.
Plain flour and breadcrumbs classified as containing wheat (not gluten-free).
Soy sauce classified as containing soy.
Egg used for coating classified as eggs allergen.
Chicken stock and chicken breast make vegetarian/vegan/pescatarian false.
No tree nuts, peanuts, fish, shellfish, sesame, or milk confidently present; set to null where ambiguous.
instructions:
Prep:15min  ›  Cook:30min  ›  Ready in:45min 

For the curry sauce: Heat oil in medium non-stick saucepan, add onion and garlic and cook until softened. Stir in carrots and cook over low heat for 10 to 12 minutes.
Add flour and curry powder; cook for 1 minute. Gradually stir in stock until combined; add honey, soy sauce and bay leaf. Slowly bring to the boil.
Turn down heat and simmer for 20 minutes or until sauce thickens but is still of pouring consistency. Stir in garam masala. Pour the curry sauce through a sieve; return to saucepan and keep on low heat until ready to serve.
For the chicken: Season both sides of chicken breasts with salt and pepper. Place flour, egg and breadcrumbs in separate bowls and arrange in a row. Coat the chicken breasts in flour, then dip them into the egg, then coat in breadcrumbs, making sure you cover both sides.
Heat oil in large frying pan over medium-high heat. Place chicken into hot oil and cook until golden brown, about 3 or 4 minutes each side. Once cooked, place on kitchen paper to absorb excess oil.
Pour curry sauce over chicken, serve with white rice and enjoy!

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.assumptions: 4 average 125g chicken breasts, pounded thin; fully edible lean meat only

ingredients.name: plain flour
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tbsp plain white flour for dredging chicken

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.assumptions: 230ml vegetable frying oil; only ~20g absorbed by the 4 coated breasts during shallow pan-frying

ingredients.name: sunflower oil
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tbsp sunflower oil for curry sauce base (fully used)

ingredients.name: onions
ingredients.assumptions: 2 medium onions (~110g each), sliced and cooked

ingredients.name: carrot
ingredients.assumptions: 2 medium carrots (~60g each), sliced and simmered

ingredients.name: plain flour
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tbsp plain white flour for thickening curry sauce

ingredients.name: chicken stock
ingredients.assumptions: 600ml chicken stock (typical diluted value; mostly water with flavor)

ingredients.name: bay leaf
ingredients.assumptions: 1 bay leaf; negligible edible contribution after sieving and removal
